name: Call of Fire
summary: On Durotar's peaks, Call of Fire puts a shaman to a trial of flame. Telf Joolam sends the initiate to drink fire sapta, face a Minor Manifestation of Fire, and claim its ember.

sections.title: Eyes of the Flame
sections.body: On Durotar's summit, fire spirits remain hidden from untrained eyes. Drink fire sapta, a draught made from reagents gathered across the barrens and coast, and your senses sharpen to the unseen. Minor spirits and manifestations appear among the summit crags.

sections.title: Confronting the Manifestation
sections.body: A Minor Manifestation of Fire waits atop the mountain. Once the sapta takes hold, it knows you can see it and awaits your challenge. Fire answers strength and decisive action, so strike without delay. The longer the fight lasts, the more fiercely the elemental fire burns.

sections.title: The Brazier of the Dormant Flame
sections.body: After the manifestation falls, you claim its lingering heat as a glowing ember. At the summit shrine, place it in the Brazier of the Dormant Flame. The inscribed metal stays cool beneath Durotar's sun and winds until the ember meets the bowl. Then white-hot flame kindles the ritual torch.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this trial?
faq.answer: You prove your strength by facing a manifestation of fire and capturing its heat in a ritual torch. The trial earns you the right to fashion a Fire Totem.

faq.q: Why do I need to drink the fire sapta?
faq.answer: You drink fire sapta to see and touch the fire elementals atop the mountain, normally beyond mortal sight.

faq.q: Where is the Minor Manifestation of Fire found?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Fire waits at the mountain ridge's highest peak above Telf Joolam's perch in Durotar, near the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
Telf Joolam is an eccentric shaman hermit who lives high on a rocky ridge in Durotar. He guides young Horde initiates through dangerous, temperamental rites to understand fire.

faq.q: Why does the manifestation grow stronger during the fight?
aliases: why is the fire elemental so strong
faq.answer: Fire gathers strength and burns hotter as time passes. Strike decisively, since hesitation lets the spirit grow stronger.

faq.q: What happens after the brazier is lit?
faq.answer: Lighting the brazier kindles the ceremonial torch. Carry its sacred flame down the mountain to complete your Fire Totem.

angles.text: As a shaman, you learn that fire is volatile and destructive, unlike solid, unyielding earth. It consumes an indecisive caller, so focus and authority are needed to master it.
As a Horde shaman, you join orc and troll shamans climbing Durotar's red crags to prove their communion with the land's fiery spirits.
